summaryZh: Lovett-Barron 实验室研究动物在自然社会与生态情境中的脑功能，关注集体行为、内部状态调节和生态适应。团队以小型透明鱼类为模型，使用非侵入式全脑神经活动成像，研究 Danionella、斑马鱼和刺鱼。

evidence.quote: We seek to discover fundamental principles of neural function, by investigating the brains of animals behaving in their natural social and ecological contexts. We focus our studies on small translucent species of fishes, whose optical accessibility allows us to non-invasively image brain-wide neural activity. We currently study collective behaviors in Danionella fish, internal state regulation in zebrafish, and ecological adaptation in stickleback.
